fr_html: Le PRESIDENT suggère l'idée de donner la décision à la majorité de l'Assemblée sur la proposition du Conseil.
en_html: The PRESIDENT suggested that the question should be decided by a majority in the Assembly upon a proposal submitted by the Council.
